headline: Owner's compass task: a simple calibrated line ('on N of the last 60 days the rest-of-day move was smaller, so SPY finishes this side ~P%') beats the current cell table out of sample; 5/10-minute glue does not help direction.
bullets: Next 5-90 min direction stays a coin flip (48-53%) whatever the interval; finer 5/10-min marks don't change that.
The 'finishes on this side' read is mostly arithmetic: distance from the open vs how much the market usually still moves from this time.
COMPCAL: that arithmetic line (M1) beats the card's cell table on validation and forward data, and is well calibrated; yesterday's close adds nothing.
Tonight: one more counted look (scale by today's volatility), then it goes to the owner as a DECISION with the line 'Not a direction forecast'.
FAMC (after-close earnings fade) is ready but waits for earnings-timing data.
next: Vol-scaled line check, a move-size band, D2PM, then the evening PR with a COMPCAL DECISION and owner FYIs.
